decisions.decision: Re-registering a player voice socket (new socket) emits voice:drop for that pid plus voice:peers with a new gen
decisions.why: receivers must close stale inbound from the replaced registration; old socket disconnect is then a no-op

decisions.decision: On game change/reset syncVoice bumps every registered endpoint gen and clears links
decisions.why: pids are reshuffled; gen change makes speakers re-offer without a client voice:on

decisions.decision: Drops queued in syncVoice are emitted in ascending pid order
decisions.why: seat order is random per room; deterministic order is needed for the AC-11 A/B equality test

decisions.decision: Test fixture cert committed (CN=localhost, 3650d, test-only); T10 uses it without openssl
decisions.why: per tests.md; on this Windows box gen-cert.js needs OPENSSL_CONF unset because an unrelated openssl.cnf path is set globally

summary: canSpeak, handlers/voice.js, syncVoice hook, HTTPS env, gen-cert, README, test/voice.js T1-T11 done; npm test green on be/voice-over (commit 79c5a5d); http-parity not re-recorded (after FE merge).
